extracted.intended_audience: historians and general readers interested in 19th-century American Catholic missions, the Loretto sisterhood, and biographical history
extracted.subtask_description: Full-text digitized historical biography of Rev. Charles Nerinckx covering his life (1761–1824/legacy to 1876), missionary work in Kentucky and Missouri, and the founding/progress of the Loretto sisterhood and related Catholic institutions in the United States.
